nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to air units or neglecting defense, as the Terran ground army can punish a weak defense.

nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see a shift in Terran composition (e.g., more air units) or when you are ready to take a more aggressive stance.
